correctness.rationale: Read actual Git RESULT.md blob fc0c9cf0c83b786855bea7878220839a2a5c59fd and exact rational verify.py. For each ρij≥0, bivariate Gaussian conditional monotonicity gives Cov(T_i(X_i),T_j(X_j))≥0. For ρij<0, Hermite orthogonality and Cauchy–Schwarz yield Cov≥ρij s_i s_j for centered square-integrable increasing transforms. Negative edges are vertex-disjoint, so disjoint 2×2 quadratic blocks have smallest eigenvalue 1+ρij≥1+ρ*. Choosing linear increasing transforms on the most negative pair (other coordinates zero, permitted in Sei T_cw*) attains β=1+ρ*. Sending other positive weights to zero proves α=1+ρ*; if no negative edges both infima equal 1. Explicit singular rank-two correlation constructed from U,V has ρ*=-sinθ, β=α=1−sinθ>0 for 0<θ<π/2. Finite verify.py cases are algebraic checks, not the proof.
